_doc: Store ▸ Cloud: the buttons a fleet row and its Details sheet offer, IN ORDER, with their captions. The Kotlin only maps an id to what it does (StoreCloudFragment.rowAction / ApkDetailSheet.detailAction); order and wording are this file. Direct install moved OFF the row into Details beside App settings, and the row gained Stop (force-stop through the shell channel ladder ShellChannels, the same door Phone Apps' Stop uses) immediately before Uninstall. #774 split the old one-shot Install / Update into the three cache stages Download → Install → Clear (StoreStages decides which are live; Install only ever uses the cached APK). When no shell channel is armed, Stop says so and offers App settings, where Android's own Force stop lives. test-store-fleet-actions.sh holds: row ends [..., stop, uninstall], row has no direct_install, details has direct_install and app_settings, and every id has a handler.
_doc_fields: id = the verb the code dispatches on; label = the caption drawn; color = the button fill (ARGB hex) on the row. Details entries also carry `detail`, the right-hand hint on the sheet's action line.
